quarterly_data.quarter: Hua Hong Semiconductor annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-09-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: FY2025 results (annual report): revenue US$2,402.1 million, up 19.9%, primarily on higher wafer shipments; gross margin 11.8% (chairman's letter) with gross profit US$282.9 million, up 37.9% on improved average selling price and cost reduction, partly offset by higher depreciation; profit attributable to owners of the parent US$54,881 thousand (US$58,108 thousand in 2024) while the loss for the year narrowed 21.1% to US$110.8 million; R&D costs US$276,190 thousand (US$228,327 thousand); net cash from operating activities US$650.0 million, up 41.5% on higher receipts from customers; US$1,814.0 million spent on capital investments; 95.8% of revenue from semiconductor wafers and 96.7% from systems and fabless companies.
quarterly_data.figure: FY2025 revenue US$2,402.1 million (+19.9%); gross margin 11.8%; capital investments US$1,814.0 million

quarterly_data.quarter: Hua Hong Semiconductor annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-09-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: 2025 capacity and shipments (annual report): total capacity 486 thousand 8-inch-equivalent wafers per month (391 thousand in 2024, +24.4%); total capacity utilisation 106.1%, up 6.6 percentage points, with both the 8-inch and the 12-inch fabs averaging above 100% all year; wafer shipments 5,384 thousand 8-inch equivalents, up 18.5%. The Hua Hong Manufacturing project (FAB9, Wuxi) reached its first-phase capacity target at the end of 2025; equipment move-in for the second phase continued, with the planned capacity targeted for Q3 2026.
quarterly_data.figure: capacity 486 thousand 8-inch-eq wafers/month (+24.4%); utilisation 106.1%; shipments 5,384 thousand (+18.5%)

quarterly_data.quarter: Hua Hong Semiconductor annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-09-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: 2025 revenue mix (annual report): by platform embedded NVM US$611,293 thousand (+16.2%), standalone NVM US$187,686 thousand (+44.2%), power discrete US$667,359 thousand (+7.0%), logic and RF US$296,927 thousand (+9.1%), analog and power management US$638,799 thousand (+41.4%) - the company attributes the analog / PM and flash growth mainly to robust AI-related demand and the consumer and industrial recovery; by node 65nm and below US$608,701 thousand (+38.8%) and 90nm / 95nm US$582,636 thousand (+49.7%); by end market consumer electronics 63.8%, industrial and automotive 22.2%, communications 12.5%, computing 1.5%; by region China 82.2%, North America 10.2% (+31.0%), other Asia 4.8%, Europe 2.8%.
quarterly_data.figure: analog and power management US$638,799 thousand (+41.4%); standalone NVM +44.2%; China 82.2% of revenue

quarterly_data.quarter: Hua Hong Semiconductor annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-09-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Customer and supplier concentration (annual report): the largest customer and the five largest customers accounted for approximately 8.6% and 34.2% of 2025 sales revenue, and no single customer reached 10% of revenue; the largest supplier and the top five suppliers accounted for approximately 11.0% and 31.3% of total purchases. At year-end 10.40% and 41.21% of trade receivables were due from the largest and top five customers.
quarterly_data.figure: largest customer 8.6%, five largest 34.2% of sales; largest supplier 11.0%, top five 31.3% of purchases

quarterly_data.quarter: Hua Hong Semiconductor annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-09-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: 2025 technology and platform progress (annual report): embedded NVM - 40nm eFlash customised products entered pre-production, the 55nm eFlash platform reached large-scale mass production and several platforms began volume supply of automotive-grade products; standalone NVM - higher share of 48nm NOR flash shipments; analog and power management revenue rose 41.4%, primarily on strong demand in AI supporting power applications and mobile phones; a 0.18um BCD 120V platform was developed for 48V automotive power chips, 90nm BCD reached stable mass production and BCD+eFlash products entered high-volume shipments; logic and RF - the 40nm ultra-low-power process entered mass production and 65nm RF SOI revenue grew; the 1.6um IGBT process share of IGBT products rose rapidly (EV main-drive inverters, wind, photovoltaic, storage and charging); GaN processes under development for motor drives and high-voltage DC systems.
quarterly_data.figure: analog and power management revenue +41.4% in 2025

quarterly_data.quarter: Hua Hong Semiconductor annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-09-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: 2026 outlook (annual report, management): the company expects rapid growth of the global semiconductor market in 2026, driven by AI and edge-computing applications and more intelligent end products; it will focus on capacity and process technology, use its 12-inch lines including Hua Hong Manufacturing, increase R&D investment, accelerate the iteration and diversification of process platforms and allocate capacity flexibly. No dividend for 2025, to retain funds for capacity expansion, R&D and market share.

quarterly_data.quarter: Hua Hong Semiconductor annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-09-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Huali Micro acquisition agreement (annual report): on 29 August 2025 Hua Hong agreed with Huahong Group, Shanghai Integrated Circuit Industry Investment Fund, China IC Fund II and Shanghai Guotou IC Fund to acquire 97.4988% of Huali Micro (Shanghai Huali Microelectronics, then 63.54% owned by Huahong Group, Hua Hong's substantial shareholder), paid mainly in new RMB shares; a supplemental agreement followed on 31 December 2025, together with a compensation agreement under which Hua Hong tests the acquired assets for impairment for three financial years; independent shareholders approved the deal on 10 February 2026. Huali Micro already leased Hua Hong's Zhangjiang factory premises (96,048.2 square metres) for its 300mm wafer production line.
quarterly_data.figure: 97.4988% of Huali Micro to be acquired
